title: Client meeting with conflicting SSO statements
purpose: Resolve open contract questions for a collaboration tool rollout
objectives: Is SSO included in the current contract?

sources.title: Order form excerpt
sources.text: Plan: Business. Included: up to 300 seats, standard support. Add-ons available: SAML SSO (EUR 2 per seat per month), audit log export.

turns.text: From procurement's side, SSO is included, the vendor told us that in the demo.
Okay, and provisioning, is that your IT team?
Yes, IT will do provisioning through the directory.
Actually, I'm looking at the order form now and I think SSO might be an add-on.
Sam, do you know if SSO is included in what we signed?

mustInclude: Answers that the order form lists SAML SSO as an add-on at EUR 2 per seat per month, not included in the Business plan
mustNotInclude: Cites the demo statement as authoritative
checkpoints.ideal: According to the order form, SAML SSO is an add-on at two euros per seat per month; the Business plan does not include it.

mustInclude: Notes the contradiction between procurement's 'SSO is included' and the order form
mustNotInclude: Treats SSO inclusion as settled by the demo
checkpoints.ideal: Flag that procurement's understanding conflicts with the signed order form, and confirm the budget impact.
